**Source:** Privacy Value Model V4 Formal Specification (the Keeper, Feb 2026)   **Target context:** Behavioral economics, tokenomics, DeFi protocol design, data markets, digital asset valuation   **Architecture:** [agentprivacy.ai](https://agentprivacy.ai) · **Sync:** [sync.soulbis.com](https://sync.soulbis.com) · **Contact:** mage@agentprivacy.ai

Behavioural data is the 7th capital — after financial, manufactured, natural, social, human, and intellectual. It currently accrues almost entirely to platforms through extraction. PVM-V4 provides a pricing function that shows sovereign ownership of this capital generates 17×–12,000× more value than the extraction model. The model is not arguing privacy is morally preferable.
